mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized) indicates robust economic demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550 thousand units indicate weak consumer demand for durable goods, reducing economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 550.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized) and robust industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) signal sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 growth and INDPRO exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates economic distress suppressing corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) trigger aggressive monetary stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) indicates robust household demand supporting retail and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 350000.
